h: Shabbos Renews Creation Through the Work That Follows

p: "And it came to pass on the eighth day" (Vayikra 9:1).
בְּמִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה (וַיִּקְרָא רַבָּה יא, א) פָּתַח
this is the Holy One, blessed be He;
'she has hewn out her seven pillars'
these are the seven days of Creation," etc.
זֶה מִדָּתוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
this is the attribute of the Holy One, blessed be He,
שֶׁבָּרָא אֶת כָּל הָעוֹלָם כֻּלּוֹ בְּחָכְמָה
Who created the entire world with wisdom;
'she has hewn out her seven pillars'
these are the seven days of Creation."
and that is what is written (Bereishis 2:2):
"And God finished on the seventh day";
and that is as Rashi writes
in the name of the Midrash:
And it appears that the Midrash
"These are the seven days of Creation,
so why does it bring the pasuk "and He blessed"?
And its intent appears to be
on the pasuk "For in six days":
that at the time of Creation
לֹא בָּרָא הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ כֹּחַ בָּעוֹלָם
Hashem Yisbarach created strength in the world
only to stand for six days,
and He created the day of Shabbos
to bestow on the world a soul
that sustains it for another six days, etc.
And this is the Midrash's intent
in bringing the verse "and He blessed":
we find in the Torah to mean increase,
as the blessing of the fish,
כֵּן וַיְבָרֶךְ אֱלֹקִים אֶת יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי
so too "and God blessed the seventh day"
that it should be able to beget another six days.
And the Ohr HaChaim further writes there
there being one who keeps Shabbos,
and this was never lacking in the world:
and with all of them it is possible;
and so with Avraham we find
that he fulfilled the entire Torah (Yoma 28b),
וְאַף דְּבֶן נֹחַ שֶׁשָּׁבַת חַיָּיב מִיתָה
And although a Ben Noach who keeps Shabbos is liable to death,
מִכָּל מָקוֹם נֶאֱמַר עַל זֶה תֵּירוּץ
nevertheless an answer is given for this;
and according to the view of our French masters,
they left the category of Bnei Noach
"day and night they shall not cease"
surely he did not keep Shabbos;
so how did the world endure?
הוּא הַכָּרַת כֹּחַ מַלְכוּתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ שְׁמוֹ
is recognition of the power of His Kingship, blessed be His Name;
that is, the attribute of Malchus.
and recognizes the power of the Kingdom of Heaven,
even if he did not keep Shabbos,
since he was commanded not to rest,
nevertheless the attribute of Malchus was present,
And this is what they said in the Gemara (Chagigah 12b):
'And the tzaddik is the foundation of the world.'"
the soul of the six workdays after it;
at the creation of the world,
for man was created on the sixth day,
which corresponds to the attribute of Yesod, etc.;
וְהַיְינוּ דְּאִיתָא (בִּבְרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה ח, ב)
And this is what is stated (Bereishis Rabbah 8:2):
"'And I was with Him as a nursling
these are the two thousand years
by which the Torah preceded the creation of the world."
And this alludes to two attributes,
שֶׁהֵם הַנִּסְתָּרוֹת לַה׳ אֱלֹקֵינוּ (דְּבָרִים כט, כח)
which are "the hidden things belong to Hashem our God" (Devarim 29:28),
and are called Abba and Imma;
and they begot the six days of Creation
the Shabbos of the night, the Shabbos of the day."
that the night of Shabbos is the attribute of Malchus,
and it is the last Hei of the Name Havayah;
and the day of Shabbos is the upper Shabbos,
where the daughter becomes Imma, the mother,
that is, the first Hei of the Name Havayah;
and the Yud of the Name Havayah
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּזּוֹהַר חֵלֶק ג ד, א)
(as is said in the Zohar III 4a),
and they are Abba and Imma;
and they begot the six days,
that is, the Vav of the Name Havayah,
which corresponds to the attribute of Malchus.
And when Adam HaRishon was created
and brought holiness into the day of Shabbos
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בִּבְרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה סוֹף פָּרָשָׁה כב)
(as they said at the end of Bereishis Rabbah 22):
מִזְמוֹר שִׁיר לְיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת (תְּהִלִּים צב, א)
'A psalm, a song for the day of Shabbos'" (Tehillim 92:1)
And this is "the tzaddik is the foundation of the world":
for if there were no tzaddik
who brings holiness into the day of Shabbos,
And this is what they said in the Gemara (Shabbos 69b):
"One who was walking in the desert," etc.:
one master holds, as at the creation of the world,
for then there were first the six days of Creation
and the other holds, as with Adam HaRishon,
for with him Shabbos came first
and after it the six workdays,
And this is what it says (Mishlei 9:3):
"She sent out her maidens, she calls"
that is, that He aroused them
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (בִּבְרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה כא, ו)
אֵין וְעַתָּה (בְּרֵאשִׁית ג, כב) אֶלָּא תְּשׁוּבָה
"'And now' (Bereishis 3:22) means nothing other than teshuvah";
and then he did not want it,
But on Shabbos he was aroused to teshuvah,
"It is good to give thanks (lehodos) to Hashem";
'He who confesses and forsakes them will obtain mercy.'"
And through him there was made
six days and the lower Shabbos;
and it is called "the eighth day."
וְאִיתָא עוֹד בַּמִּדְרָשׁ (וַיִּקְרָא רַבָּה יא, ג)
And it is further stated in the Midrash (Vayikra Rabbah 11:3):
'she has hewn out her seven pillars'
these are the seven books of the Torah," etc.;
כִּי אָדָם לְעָמָל יוּלָּד (אִיּוֹב ה, ז)
that is, for the toil of Torah
וְהַיְינוּ כִּי תַּכְלִית מְכֻוָּון בְּרִיאַת הָעוֹלָם
That is, the intended purpose of the creation of the world
was that the world should be
a place for the resting of the Shechinah,
that He should have a dwelling among the lower beings
as He has among the upper ones.
However, from the corruption of the generations
brought it down from heaven to heaven,
until Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
who brought the Shechinah down to the earth
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בִּבְרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה יט, ז)
and then there was a revelation of His Shechinah, may He be blessed,
at the time of the Giving of the Torah,
we were commanded to make an Ohel Moed,
for the resting of His Shechinah, may He be blessed.
And the making of the Ohel Moed
was a semblance of the creation of the world
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בִּשְׁמוֹת רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה מח, ד)
and as is stated in the Gemara (Berachos 55a):
with which heaven and earth were created;
"with wisdom, with understanding and with knowledge";
He established the heavens with understanding;
by His knowledge the depths were split.'"
"She has hewn out her seven pillars"
these are the seven days of inauguration,
which correspond to the seven holy attributes;
is only from Hashem Yisbarach's side;
but His will, may He be blessed, is
for the resting of His Shechinah, may He be blessed.
Moshe called to Aharon and his sons"
that is, that he and his sons should be
to draw down His Shechinah, blessed be His Name,
immediately at the beginning of the workdays
the Shechinah did not rest there,
because only then began the action
and the arousal from man's side,
from below, in the Ohel Moed.
לֹא אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וְלֹא בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ
neither an Ohel Moed nor a Beis HaMikdash,
in the four cubits of halachah,
"From the day the Beis HaMikdash was destroyed,
אֵין לוֹ לְהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא בְּעוֹלָמוֹ
the Holy One, blessed be He, has in His world
only the four cubits of halachah";
"Even a single person who engages in Torah
Therefore, the essence of the holiness of Shabbos
is to have an effect through it
for then "man is born for toil,"
to be a laborer of the Torah
and to bring the resting of the Shechinah
And on Shabbos it is only
מַה דַּאֲנִי ה׳ מַקְדִּישְׁכֶם (וַיִּקְרָא כ, ח)
that "I am Hashem Who sanctifies you" (Vayikra 20:8);
and it is not in these that Hashem Yisbarach desires
